nodes.description: Testable.timerAddress: address of timer override contract, 0x0 in production.
Voting.migratedAddress: address of the migrated Voting contract, gates access.
Voting.priceRequests: mapping of price request id to PriceRequest storage.
Voting.pendingPriceRequests: array of unresolved price request ids.
Voting.rounds: mapping of roundId to Round (snapshotId, inflationRate, gatPercentage, rewardsExpirationTime).
PricelessPositionManager.positions: mapping of sponsor to PositionData.
Global raw collateral across all sponsor positions.
Synthetic token contract held/managed by the financial contract.
ERC20 collateral token backing all positions.
Liquidatable.liquidations: mapping of sponsor to LiquidationData array.
Total raw collateral currently locked in liquidations.
Timestamp of emergency shutdown, 0 when not shut down.
Lockable reentrancy guard flag.
Timer.currentTime: test time store, seeded from block.timestamp.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and position ownership.
Miner-influenced time source used by Testable/Timer and time-gated logic.
LiquidationWithdrawer.withdrawLiquidation: forwards withdrawal to an arbitrary financial contract address.
Voting.requestPrice: enqueues a price request, gated by onlyRegisteredContract.
Voting.commitVote: stores a voter commitment during commit phase.
Voting.revealVote: verifies and records a revealed vote and snapshotted balance.
Voting.snapshotCurrentRound: freezes round variables using an EOA signature check.
Voting.retrieveRewards: computes and mints voter rewards for resolved price requests.
Voting.setMigrated: owner-only setter of the migrated address.
Liquidatable.createLiquidation: liquidates a sponsor position using synthetics and a final fee bond.
Liquidatable.dispute: disputes a pending liquidation and requests a DVM price.
Liquidatable.withdrawLiquidation: settles a liquidation and disperses rewards to sponsor/liquidator/disputer.
Position manager create: deposits collateral and mints synthetic tokens.
Position manager redeem: burns synthetics and returns proportional collateral.
settleExpired: post-expiry settlement using resolved oracle price.
Emergency shutdown entrypoint restricted to FinancialContractsAdmin.
Withdrawable.withdraw: role-gated ETH withdrawal via Address.sendValue.
Withdrawable.withdrawErc20: role-gated ERC20 withdrawal.
Store.payOracleFees: receives ETH oracle fees.
OptimisticOracle.settleAndGetPrice: settles request and returns resolved price.
VotingUpgrader.upgrade: governor-gated atomic upgrade of Voting and ownership transfers.
Governor.executeProposal: executes a passed governance transaction via low-level call.
External call to attacker-supplied financialContractAddress.withdrawLiquidation.
safeTransfer of collateralCurrency to a caller/derived address.
Minting of synthetic tokenCurrency to msg.sender.
External call to OptimisticOracle.settleAndGetPrice inside funding-rate update.
votingToken.mint of accumulated voter rewards.
Low-level .call used by Address.sendValue and Governor._executeCall.
Inline assembly sstore to set proposals array length in Governor constructor.
Parameter: address of financial contract to withdraw from.
Parameter: index identifying a liquidation.
Parameter: sponsor address of the position/liquidation.
Parameter: price feed identifier bytes32.
Parameter: timestamp of the price request.
Parameter: arbitrary ancillary data appended to a price request.
Parameter: voting round id for reward retrieval.
Parameter: voter for which rewards are retrieved.
Parameter: new migrated Voting contract address.
Local: cached getCurrentTime() value.
Local: computed current voting round id.
Local: keccak256-encoded price request id.
Local: PriceRequest storage reference.
Local: VoteInstance storage reference for the current round.
Local: VoteSubmission storage reference for msg.sender.
Local: fee-adjusted collateral actually withdrawn.
Local: accumulated voter reward to mint.
Local: LiquidationData storage reference.

edges.reason: msg.sender keys voteSubmissions and must be the committer.
msg.sender is bound into the reveal hash and submission lookup.
msg.sender must equal migratedAddress when migrated, gating reward claims.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender before overwriting migratedAddress.
msg.sender becomes the liquidator and pays tokens/fees.
msg.sender becomes the disputer and pays the dispute bond.
permissionless caller triggers reward dispersal.
emergencyShutdown requires msg.sender == FinancialContractsAdmin.
onlyRoleHolder(roleId) checks msg.sender before ETH send.
onlyRoleHolder(roleId) checks msg.sender before ERC20 transfer.
upgrade requires msg.sender == governor.
executeProposal is permissionless but gates value and ordering.
Timestamp dependency: require(time <= blockTime) via getCurrentTime.
Commit phase window is derived from block timestamp.
Reveal phase and round id derived from block timestamp.
Snapshot allowed only during the reveal phase computed from time.
Deadline and liquidation liveness depend on current time.
withdrawable() depends on liquidation expiry derived from time.
onlyPostExpiration compares current time to expiration.
Shutdown timestamp is set from current block time.
Settlement of optimistic request depends on expiration time.
Timer constructor seeds currentTime with block.timestamp.
blockTime local derives from getCurrentTime/block.timestamp.
LiquidationWithdrawer forwards the call to an arbitrary financial contract.
retrieveRewards mints voting tokens to the voter.
createLiquidation transfers collateral and burns synthetics before returning.
withdrawLiquidation transfers collateral after state deletion; external token call.
create mints synthetic tokens to msg.sender.
redeem transfers collateral back to the caller.
settleExpired transfers collateral at expiry settled price.
Withdrawable.withdraw uses Address.sendValue low-level call to msg.sender.
settleAndGetPrice performs external oracle call during state updates.
Governor executes arbitrary transactions via low-level call.
Governor constructor assembly writes the proposals array length slot.
requestPrice pushes a new id to pendingPriceRequests.
commitVote writes the submission into priceRequests.
revealVote updates the vote instance within priceRequests.
snapshotCurrentRound writes snapshotId/inflation/gat into rounds.
retrieveRewards deletes reveal hashes in priceRequests vote instances.
setMigrated writes migratedAddress.
createLiquidation pushes a LiquidationData entry.
createLiquidation adds locked collateral to rawLiquidationCollateral.
withdrawLiquidation deletes the liquidation entry.
withdrawLiquidation removes payouts from rawLiquidationCollateral.
create updates the caller position.
create increases rawTotalPositionCollateral.
create calls mint on tokenCurrency.
redeem reduces or deletes the caller position.
settleExpired decrements rawTotalPositionCollateral.
emergencyShutdown sets emergencyShutdownTimestamp.
payOracleFeesErc20 pulls the fee token via safeTransferFrom.
financialContractAddress parameter is the external call target.
liquidationId parameter is forwarded to the callee.
sponsor parameter is forwarded to the callee.
Attacker-controlled address flows into the low-level external call.
sponsor parameter selects the position to liquidate.
sponsor parameter selects the liquidation to dispute.
sponsor parameter selects the liquidation to withdraw.
identifier parameter is hashed into the price request id.
time parameter is hashed into the price request id.
ancillaryData parameter is stored and hashed into the request id.
roundId parameter selects the round for reward computation.
voterAddress parameter is the reward recipient.
newVotingAddress parameter is stored in migratedAddress.
blockTime local gates requestPrice timing checks.
currentRoundId local selects the priceRequest vote instance.
priceRequestId local indexes priceRequests storage.
priceRequest local is mutated with the new commitment.
voteInstance local holds the revealed vote state.
voteSubmission local verifies and stores the reveal hash.
amountWithdrawn local is returned and transferred to the caller.
totalRewardToIssue local is minted as voting token reward.
liquidation local holds state used for reward computation.

normalization_plan.reason: financialContractAddress is a call parameter directly consumed by withdrawLiquidation.
liquidationId is a call parameter forwarded by withdrawLiquidation.
sponsor is a call parameter forwarded by withdrawLiquidation.
roundId selects the round processed by retrieveRewards.
voterAddress is the recipient in retrieveRewards.
blockTime is a temporary used inside requestPrice.
currentRoundId is a temporary used inside commitVote.
priceRequestId is derived and used inside requestPrice.
priceRequest storage reference is used inside commitVote.
voteInstance storage reference is used inside revealVote.
voteSubmission storage reference is used inside revealVote.
totalRewardToIssue accumulates the minted reward in retrieveRewards.
liquidation storage reference is used inside withdrawLiquidation.
